summary.text: Josh Branscum, listed by Ballotpedia as Joshua Branscum, is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 83 who has served since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is an executive with Branscum Construction.

paragraphs.text: Joshua Branscum was born and lives in Russell Springs, Kentucky.
He earned a B.A. in organizational communications from Georgetown College in 2005 and a B.S. in construction management from Eastern Kentucky University in 2007.
His career experience includes working as executive vice president of Branscum Construction.
Branscum took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2021, succeeding Jeffrey Hoover.

In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Economic Development and Workforce Investment Committee and was also assigned to the Elections, Constitutional Amendments and Intergovernmental Affairs Committee and the Transportation Committee.
